description: This Java interface defines a contract for 'Sudo' search commands within the 'thing-search' module, specifying constants and default methods related to resource path, resource type, and type prefix.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JsonPointer indicating that the resource path is not needed for SudoCommands.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string for sudo commands.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix string for sudo commands.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for the command.
